name: meridian-crossing
description: Reference prototype for Archetype 5: collaborating, self-directed agents (Meridian Crossing).

scripts.suppliers: pnpm build && pnpm identity:issue && concurrently -k -n summit,cascade,alpine,ridge -c green,blue,yellow,red "node --import ./infra/env.mjs packages/supplier-summit/dist/index.js" "node --import ./infra/env.mjs packages/supplier-cascade/dist/index.js" "node --import ./infra/env.mjs packages/supplier-alpine/dist/index.js" "node --import ./infra/env.mjs packages/supplier-ridge/dist/index.js"
scripts.demo: pnpm build && pnpm identity:issue && pnpm dir:up && node --import ./infra/env.mjs infra/demo.mjs
scripts.sample: pnpm build && pnpm identity:issue && node --import ./infra/env.mjs infra/sample.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm identity:issue && pnpm clean && pnpm build && node --test packages/*/dist/*.test.js packages/dashboard/*.test.mjs infra/*.test.mjs
